terms.definition: A normalized theological proposition/concept counted once even when similar language recurs in multiple documents.
Affirmative language about who God is or what God does.
Language describing God by negation, denial, or limits placed on creaturely categories.
The same or substantially equivalent proposition is affirmed at the controlling semantic floor.
A genuine concern is shared, but ontology, mechanism, scope, or metaphysical interpretation is materially changed.
The historical proposition, at its accepted scope, is incompatible with authoritative Restoration teaching.
Available evidence is insufficient for a responsible classification.
Teaching label for inherited A rows.
Teaching label for inherited Q rows; descriptive comparison, not proof of primitive-Christian recovery.
Teaching label for inherited D rows; does not establish historical origin or corruption.
Teaching label for A01–A26 Restoration additions relative to the admitted historical creed/confession corpus.
The minimum proposition that controls a comparison; prevents a shared term from importing all of a tradition's thicker metaphysical entailments.
Canonical scripture in the project source-role model.
Collective / strongly authoritative official doctrine in the project source-role model.
Attributable prophetic / apostolic exposition in the project source-role model.
Present as a positive Restoration proposition but absent as a substantive positive doctrine from the admitted historical creed/confession corpus.
An earlier biblical, patristic, medieval, or later-Christian analogue; analogue does not automatically mean exact equivalence.
Independent blinded coding planned for scholarly publication; not yet completed in the current project state.
For teaching use: shared discipleship and common faith need not imply total conformity of doctrinal interpretation.
A/Q/D means the inherited predicate is source-attested for that tradition in the working source-report reconstruction and carries the current Latter-day Saint comparison code; NL means not located.
No admitted source in the working reconstruction was located for the predicate. It is a comparison gap, not a denial and not proof of absence from the tradition.
A tradition denominator includes only inherited predicates explicitly attested by an admitted tradition-specific source.
Source-report reconstruction. Used where the accepted aggregate/profile controls are known but the exact Session 19B final cell artifact is not currently recovered.
The institution, jurisdiction, or historical confessional family to which a source can responsibly be attributed; broad family inflation is prohibited.
Provisional A/Q/D distribution among source-attested predicates for one tradition family; not a publication-final closeness ranking.
A statement limited to what the controlled cells, counts, proportions, or source-attested breadth directly display.
A bounded interpretation that follows from the observed pattern if the corpus, coding, and source-scope assumptions are accepted.
A plausible competing explanation or methodological challenge that should be considered before treating an inference as settled.
A stronger claim the current data do not establish, such as treating NL as denial or predicate counts as proof of historical causation.
The workbook layer connecting formula-derived metrics to observations, bounded inferences, counterinterpretations, drill-down evidence, and teaching prompts.

Eastern Orthodox teaching affirms divine simplicity, but the Orthodox distinction between God's essence and His energies means the Western formula "without parts" is not simply equivalent; this cell stays pending review rather than being coded D.

hazard_types.plain_language: A short slogan is true but omits distinctions needed to predict the theology.
Same term is used with materially different semantic content.
Two teachings/practices appear inconsistent until layers are distinguished.
Ecclesial recognition/status is confused with standing before God.
Absence from a reviewed source is mistaken for doctrinal rejection.
Historical antecedence is mistaken for identity/equivalence.
Relational language is confused with a thicker metaphysical claim.
A tradition family is mistaken for a single uniform body.
hazard_types.app_rule: Often auto cue when variation is material.

hazard_types.plain_language: A source's institutional authority or jurisdictional scope is overgeneralized.
A broad label is mistaken for a thicker proposition than the controlled floor.

rendered_states.public_meaning: Substantive agreement at the controlled proposition floor.
rendered_states.rendering_rule: Render positive agreement; source/scope drill-down required.

rendered_states.public_meaning: Source-floor agreement: source attests a narrower proposition wholly within the shared floor; master family may remain Q.
rendered_states.rendering_rule: Render distinctly from A; explain source-floor qualification.
Render shared concern plus material reinterpretation.

rendered_states.public_meaning: Direct divergence at the controlled scope.
rendered_states.rendering_rule: Render divergence with exact scope and comparator source.

rendered_states.public_meaning: All required atomic layers recovered, but family is intrinsically multi-layered.
rendered_states.rendering_rule: Render multi-segment vector, never collapse to one A/Q/D tile.

rendered_states.public_meaning: Split family has unresolved or unrecovered atomic layer(s).
Evidence exists but semantic or scope review remains.
Historical/current family state conflict not reconciled.
Proposition evidence exists but source role is not approved for branch-level claim.
Historical witness retired; no current institutional source certified.
Current controlling standard reviewed; exact predicate not attested.
rendered_states.rendering_rule: Render explicit reviewed gap; never infer denial.

rendered_states.public_meaning: Evidence recovery has not yet reached this branch×predicate cell.
No evidence currently suitable for public display.
Source architecture excludes the cell from current branch analysis.
